run_data_loader_benchmark: run the data loader benchmark script to measure minibatch loading and dequeue performance across GPUs
run_loader_loop: run the loader loop function to time 100 iterations of get_next_minibatch calls on a RoIDataLoader
run_parse_args: run the parse_args function to parse CLI arguments for num-batches, sleep, cfg, x-factor, and profiler options
run_main_benchmark: run the main benchmark function to create a RoIDataLoader, build a Caffe2 dequeue net, and measure dequeue times
run_profiler_benchmark: run the profiler flag to use cProfile on the loader loop and sort results by cumulative time
